name: Ciudad Monumental
tagline: Living inside a golden-stone medieval maze
description: The walled UNESCO old town of palaces, towers and cobbled squares like the Plaza de San Jorge. Storks nest on the rooftops and film crews use its lanes. Atmospheric and historic, though quiet and short on everyday shops.
bestFor: History lovers wanting to live amid spectacular medieval architecture and calm

name: Plaza Mayor and Canovas
tagline: The lively, walkable heart of town
description: The busy modern centre spilling out from the Plaza Mayor along the Canovas avenue. This is where cafes, tapas bars, shops and daily life concentrate, giving the most convenient and sociable base with everything within an easy stroll.
bestFor: Nomads wanting cafes, amenities and social buzz within walking distance
pros: Best choice of cafes and bars

name: Nuevo Caceres and Ruta de la Plata
description: Newer residential districts of apartment blocks, wide streets and everyday amenities away from the tourist core. Calm, practical and family-oriented, these areas offer more space and value, at the cost of a longer walk to the historic centre.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting space, quiet and better-value modern flats

name: Aldea Moret and the university side
description: The southern side towards the university campus and the old Aldea Moret industrial quarter. A younger, more affordable area with student flats, cheap eats and a workaday feel, further from the monumental core but well connected by bus.
bestFor: Budget-minded nomads happy with a student vibe and cheaper rents
